verdict.rationale: Windows officially supports a huge range of third-party hardware and accessories (windows-docs-10, windows-docs-11) and targets power users with high-performance custom hardware (windows-docs-8), suggesting no hardware vendor lock-in. However, community evidence describes increasing lock-in via mandatory Microsoft account sign-in, forced telemetry, and reduced ability to run Windows independently of Microsoft services (windows-comm-6, windows-comm-7, windows-comm-8, windows-comm-11, windows-comm-13), directly contradicting the 'without vendor lock-in' claim.
